name: Renato Moicano

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (71 in height, 72 in reach, orthodox). Last fight: lost to Tom Nolan by TKO (R3 1:28) at UFC Vegas 123, Las Vegas, 2026-10-31 (Cageside Press, AgentMMA, Boxing News); before that a rear-naked-choke win over Chris Duncan at UFC Vegas 115 in April 2026.

photo_coverage: Good. Front: ESPN studio headshot and a Commons video still (CC BY 3.0, cap on). Three-quarter: two 2026 media-day stills (April, October), the ESPN full-body three-quarter and the Oct 31 2026 pre-fight frame. Profile: April 2026 face-off (left side, small). Physique: two ESPN full-body cutouts and the Oct 30 2026 weigh-in. Action: Oct 31 2026 vs Nolan. Only one free-licence photo is usable (the 2024 Commons still and a fan graphic did not download: Wikimedia returned HTTP 429 all session).

face.shape: Long and fairly narrow, close to rectangular: tall forehead, flat cheeks, angular jaw hidden under the beard. Reads lean and bony at fight weight.
face.jaw: Medium width with defined angles; the beard squares it off further.
face.chin: Medium height, slightly forward in profile, blunt; covered by the beard.
face.cheekbones: Moderately high and visible, with flat to slightly hollow cheeks below.
face.brow_ridge: Pronounced: the brows sit low on a forward brow, so the eyes look deep-set and shadowed.
face.forehead: High and broad, with three or four deep horizontal creases and vertical frown lines between the brows; temples recede so the forehead looks taller at the corners.

eyes.shape: Almond, slightly narrow, heavy upper lids; outer corners level to slightly down, giving a tired or sceptical look in press photos.

eyebrows.shape: Low and nearly straight, heavier at the inner ends, often drawn together in a frown; slight downward tail at the outer ends.

nose.width: Narrow to medium bridge; the lower nose widens into a fleshy, rounded tip and medium nostrils.
nose.bridge: Straight and fairly high; no visible deviation from the front.
nose.hump: None to very slight; the profile is straight.
nose.tip: Bulbous and rounded, slightly drooping in profile (the tip sits a little below the nostrils' line).
nose.fight_damage: No clear deviation or flattening visible. A tiny bright dot at the edge of one nostril in the Oct 2026 media-day still may be a small stud or just a highlight; not seen in other photos, so ignore unless confirmed.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-wide mouth with a thin upper lip and medium lower lip; straight, closed resting line, often a slight downturned frown. Moustache covers the upper lip edge.

ears.protrusion: Clearly stick out from the head, mostly at the top; prominent from the front because the sides are faded short.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Mild: his left ear shows a thick, rolled, slightly lumpy upper rim in the ESPN headshot; his right ear is slightly thickened at the top. Not the swollen kind.

face.notable_marks_scars: Deep forehead creases and frown lines; no large scar visible. Neck tattoo (tribal) up the left side of his neck to the jaw.

hair.style: Short textured crop on top (about 3-4 cm, pushed forward and up) with a skin fade on the sides and back, fading from skin above the ears; receding temples. Same cut in April and October 2026 and in the ESPN cutouts.
hair.colour: Dark brown, slightly lighter at the tips under studio light.
hair.hairline: Receding at both temples (an M shape with deep corners) and a central forelock area; the front sits high on a tall forehead.
hair.texture: Straight to slightly wavy, medium thickness.

facial_hair.colour: Dark brown with lighter brown and a few lighter hairs at the chin; the moustache is darker.

colour_samples.espn_headshot_chin_box_265,270,330,295: #865642 (skin shows through, so colour_hex is darker than the raw sample)

facial_hair.density: Dense on the moustache, chin and jawline; lighter and shorter on the upper cheeks.
facial_hair.shape: Short boxed beard: a full moustache joined to a chin beard that runs along the jaw to the sideburns, neckline under the jaw, cheeks lightly stubbled. Kept at a similar length in 2025-2026.

tone_samples.light: studio, body a stop darker than the face

skin.tone_note: Each sample is the median of a box on lit skin (box in source pixels); the shadowed right cheek in the April 2026 still (#885545) was left out, and the over-bright studio forehead is not in the used average. Studio cutouts read lighter and pinker, media-day stills darker; the used average mixes them on purpose.
skin.undertone: Warm to neutral-olive; turns pinkish under stage light.
skin.freckles_marks: Visible skin texture and a few small marks on the cheeks; moderate body hair on the forearms and shins.

body.build: Lean, athletic lightweight at 180 cm with a reach slightly longer than his height; medium frame, not bulky.
body.body_fat_notes: Visible abs and oblique lines at the Oct 2026 weigh-in and in both studio cutouts; defined but not shredded-dry.
body.shoulders: Medium width, rounded delts, moderately sloping.
body.chest: Moderately developed, flat pecs; chest fully covered by tattoos.
body.arms: Lean and sinewy, medium biceps, defined forearms; fully sleeved.
body.legs_calves: Long, lean legs; slim thighs and moderate calves.
body.posture: Upright, shoulders slightly forward, head level; at weigh-ins he stands square and loose.
body.notable_physique_traits: Heavily tattooed torso and both arms, faded haircut with protruding ears, long narrow face with a short dark boxed beard.

tattoos.where: Upper chest, across both pecs below the collarbones
tattoos.description: Large black ornate script reading 'Sagrada Familia' with swirl flourishes.
tattoos.size: About 35 cm wide x 10 cm tall

tattoos.where: Left arm sleeve (shoulder, chest edge, upper arm and forearm to the wrist), continuing up the left side of the neck
tattoos.description: Full black Polynesian/Maori-style tribal sleeve: bands, spearhead and shell patterns covering the left pec, deltoid, upper back of the shoulder and the whole arm; a tribal strip runs up the left neck to the jaw.
tattoos.size: Full sleeve plus left pec, shoulder and neck

tattoos.description: Full black-and-grey realism sleeve: clouds and a praying figure on the upper arm, a city skyline and numerals on the inner forearm, shading throughout; a sacred heart wrapped in a crown of thorns on the inner upper arm (UFC 317 photo).

tattoos.where: Right side of the ribcage, under the armpit
Right shin and calf, knee to ankle
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey piece: a line of script below the knee, a statue figure with outstretched arms in the middle, and a skull near the ankle.

accessories_seen: Gold chain with a cross pendant (UFC 317 weigh-in 2025); clear in-ear monitors and a black UFC cap in his YouTube studio; gold wristwatch at April 2026 media day.

kit.typical_shorts: Yellow UFC shorts in every studio cutout and on fight night: yellow with black tiger-stripe pattern and a black waistband (older cutout); yellow with a dark leaf/chevron pattern and black waistband panel (newer cutout, crypto.com logo); Oct 31 2026: yellow with a dark scale pattern, black waistband and green 'MOICANO' lettering on the left leg. Black UFC gloves.
kit.gloves: Black UFC gloves; red tape seen on Nolan's gloves, Moicano's corner colour not confirmed.
kit.brand_note: Logos visible on the shorts: UFC, crypto.com (newer), Venum (older).

stance_and_guard.seen_in_photos: Oct 31 2026 vs Nolan: when hurt he shells up high with both gloves at the temples, elbows tight to the ribs, chin tucked and knees bent. No clean neutral-stance photo was found, so do not infer guard height or foot width from these images.

render_hints.beard: short boxed beard about 9 mm, #4a3226, densest on the moustache and chin
render_hints.tattoos: both arms sleeved (left tribal, right black-and-grey), chest script, left-neck tribal

morphs_extra._note: Targets from assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (read by src/avatar3d.js from this block). l- = the fighter's own left. Protruding ears and a thicker left upper rim; fleshy nose tip.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, tattoos, build and skin; medium-high for face proportions (one sharp studio front, a free-licence front with a cap, three 2026 three-quarters, one small profile); medium for morph values. What to watch: (1) long narrow face with a tall, creased forehead and receding temples; (2) thick low brows over deep-set, heavy-lidded brown eyes; (3) long straight nose ending in a fleshy rounded tip; (4) protruding ears on a skin-faded head, mild thickening on his left ear; (5) short dark boxed beard with a fuller moustache; (6) 'Sagrada Familia' chest script, left tribal sleeve up the neck, right black-and-grey sleeve, right-shin piece; (7) lean 180 cm frame, do not bulk him up. ageOldM uses (years-25)/65 like src/avatar3d.js. Only one embed-ok photo is in the folder (Commons rate limit); re-run the Commons download for File:Renato_Moicano_2024.png if a second free photo is needed.
